title: observability(install): automate Prometheus/Grafana + log shipping + alerts for Private installs
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: Private installations (VPC/on-prem) need a repeatable, auditable observability stack that matches hosted guarantees. This PR adds automation for provisioning Prometheus + Grafana, log shipping (Vector), baseline dashboards, and alerting rules as part of the private-installer and terraform flows.

What this changes: - Terraform module: redwood-terraform/modules/private-observability which creates namespaced resources (ServiceAccount, PrometheusOperator CRs, PrometheusRule, Alertmanager config secret placeholder), integrates with existing private VPC networking outputs, and exposes a toggle for managed Alertmanager vs customer-provided. - Helm: updates to redwood-helm-charts/prometheus-grafana chart with opinionated values for private installs (RBAC, nodeSelectors, tolerations, storage classes) and automated values templating for tenant scoping. - Log shipping: adds redwood-helm-charts/vector chart values and example unit to ship application logs to a central receive endpoint with TLS and credential templating. - Dashboards: includes curated Grafana dashboards (redwood-grafana/dashboards) for serving runtime, request-level latencies, token spend, cache hit ratios, queue depth, and node GPU utilization. Dashboards are added as ConfigMaps and packaged by the chart. - Alerting rules: PrometheusRule manifests for SLO/latency-based alerts, low-cache-hit and high-kv-cache-eviction alerts, and persistent storage fill. - Installer hooks: private-installer (redwood-private-installer) now calls the terraform module during the `deploy-observability` step and applies Helm charts with a documented upgrade/rollback strategy (pre-deploy checks, canary upgrade for Grafana, automated rollback on failed post-deploy probes).

Checklist: - [x] Terraform module implementing resources and outputs - [x] Helm chart changes and values schema update - [x] Grafana dashboards and JSON model export - [x] PrometheusRule alerting + sensible defaults - [x] Vector log-shipping example + TLS credentialing - [x] e2e smoke tests for install/upgrade/rollback in CI - [x] Docs: private-installer observability walkthrough and upgrade notes

Testing and validation: - Unit/linters: helm lint, terraform validate/plan-diff run in CI. - Integration: e2e-private-installer job spins up a small Kind cluster with simulated VPC outputs and runs the terraform module + helm upgrade flow, validates Prometheus targets, dashboard provisioning and that at least one alert fires for a synthetic high-latency rule. - Manual: validated on a staging private install in our internal VPC with customer-like node labels and storage classes.

Backward compatibility and upgrade notes: - Defaults are opt-in for existing Private installs. The terraform module is not applied unless `enable_observability=true` is set in the installer config to avoid accidental resource creation. - Helm chart follows semantic upgrades; the installer uses a canary release pattern for Grafana to avoid dashboard overwrite regressions. - Rollback: installer captures previous release revision and performs helm rollback if post-deploy probes fail.

Security notes: - Secrets are passed via KMS-encrypted terraform variables into Kubernetes secrets. We added guidance for integrating HSM/KMS in the docs. - Grafana admin password remains customer-managed for Private installs by default.

Related: ENG-3124 (observability automation for private installs), SUP-4582 (customer request for pre-packaged dashboards/alerts).

review_comments: Alex Romero (2025-10-04): Please confirm how secrets are provisioned for Alertmanager and Grafana admin passwords - we should document KMS/HSM integration.
Maya Chen (2025-10-04): Secrets are passed via terraform with KMS encryption; added docs section and examples for both KMS and HSM.
Priya Natarajan (2025-10-06): Can we make observability optional by default for existing installs? Concerned about surprise resource creation.
Maya Chen (2025-10-06): Default is opt-in: enable_observability=false. Installer will not apply module unless explicitly enabled. Added explicit guard in deploy script.
Samir Patel (2025-10-08): e2e job flaked due to timing of Prometheus target registration - added retry + wait-for-targets helper in the test harness.
CI Bot (2025-10-10): helm-lint failed on dashboard ConfigMap name length - shortened identifiers and re-run succeeded.
release_notes: Adds optional observability automation for Private installs: terraform module, helm charts for Prometheus/Grafana/Vector, curated dashboards, and alerting rules. Opt-in via enable_observability flag in the private-installer. Includes upgrade/rollback documentation.
merge_summary: Merged after final approval from reviewers and CI green. Can be rolled back with installer helm rollback flow if post-deploy probes fail.
